name: @rivi-software/agentic-seo-check
stderr:
Agentic SEO Check 1.1.1 · SEO and AEO analysis for coding agents

  Audits URLs, static build output or raw HTML for search engines (audit, crawl)
  and AI answer engines (aeo), and prints machine-readable findings.

Usage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  agentic-seo-check <command> [options]

Audit commands ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  audit <target>                  Audit a page, a site (--crawl), a build
                                  directory or raw HTML
  crawl <url>                     Crawl a site and audit every page (same as
                                  "audit --crawl")
  aeo <target>                    Answer engine optimization (AEO) audit, with
                                  its own score
  compare <url> <competitors...>  Compare a page with competitors' pages, and
                                  what it lacks

Other commands ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  rules                           List the rules this tool can report
  install-browser                 Download Chromium for --render and
                                  --lighthouse
  mcp                             Start the MCP server on stdio (for Claude
                                  Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.)
  telemetry [action]              Show, turn off or turn on the anonymous usage
                                  data
  help [command]                  Show the help for a command

Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  -V, --version                   Show the version
  -h, --help                      Show this help

Examples ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  $ agentic-seo-check audit https://www.example.com/pricing
  $ agentic-seo-check crawl https://www.example.com
  $ agentic-seo-check aeo https://www.example.com
  $ agentic-seo-check audit ./dist --base-url https://www.example.com
  $ agentic-seo-check audit https://www.example.com -o report.md

  Each command's options: agentic-seo-check <command> --help

Made by RIVI Software (https://rivi.software). Docs and issues: https://github.com/rivi-software/agentic-seo-check
